items.claim_text: Researchers studied more than 30 million credit card payments in New York City taxis, and found that higher suggested tip rates led passengers to leave more money.

C1.reason: Researchers and New York City taxi passengers align with the Ledger, but the article’s “more than 30 million” conflicts with F-002’s “more than 13 million”; it also broadens the causal finding beyond credit-card users who happened to see a higher recommended-tip menu.
